# Doing It
> Free, open-source (MIT) Windows 10/11 desktop widget combining tasks, markdown notes, a Pomodoro focus timer, a daily journal, analytics and iCalendar sync. Local-first, no accounts, no telemetry.

## Overview
Doing It is a frameless, local-first Windows 10 and 11 productivity companion that stays always-on-top or docks to screen edges. It unifies natural language task capture, markdown scratchpad notes, Pomodoro focus intervals with procedural ambient audio synthesizers, a daily journal with voice reflections, 0-100 rhythm analytics, and RFC 5545 iCalendar synchronization.

## Key Features
- **Local-First & Offline**: All tasks, notes, habits, and journals are stored in `%APPDATA%/doing-it/doing-it-data.json`. Zero telemetry, zero external tracking, and no account required. Network access occurs only for user-configured external iCalendar feeds and OpenGraph link previews.
- **Always-On-Top & Edge Docking**: Pin to the foreground above full-screen editors and browsers, or snap to screen boundaries for a full-height sidebar.
- **Tasks & Habit Streaks**: Smart sections (Today, Upcoming, Backlog, Completed), inline editing, and habit streaks with automatic midnight reset.
- **Focus Studio**: Circular countdown timer, task linkage, and Web Audio procedural ambient soundscapes (Brown Noise, Rainfall, Forest Breeze, Lo-Fi binaural beats).
- **Daily Journal**: 5-point mood tracking, guided reflective prompts, zero-dependency audio voice recording (Web MediaRecorder), and markdown export.
- **Calendar Synchronization**: Private RFC 5545 `.ics` feeds from Google Calendar, Outlook, Fastmail, or Apple iCloud with 1-click meeting join links (Teams, Zoom, Google Meet).
- **Command Palette**: `Ctrl+K` keyboard launcher for instantaneous fuzzy search and navigation.
